datePolicy: Source access dates are retained from the original November 5, 2026 register. This offline article adaptation did not revisit external sources; editing dates are not source refresh dates. Publication, effective and historical benchmark dates remain distinct from access dates.
uncertainties: Future March 2027 trip: November 5, 2026 observations are not refreshed prices, availability, reservations or a forecast. MXN 18 = USD 1 is a planning assumption; no CAD conversion or live exchange rate is given.

Only Narvarte lead 1 advertises a window expressly covering March 2027; one-month acceptance and all-in costs remain unknown. Other units are comparators; yearless dates are not March evidence. One prefers six months, four omit size, one has layout conflicts and one has a price conflict.

Deposits are extra liquidity, not consumption; refund is not guaranteed. Utility caps, taxes, cleaning, fees, cancellation, lawful rental authority, exact addresses and tested internet remain incomplete. No property/landlord inspection or inquiry performed.

Co-Madre lower shop figures likely exclude IVA but this is inference, not checkout verification. Current hours, access, coworking cancellation/deposit obligations and seat availability need confirmation.

Official transport operator hosts were unavailable; successfully read government visitor pages support published fares, not live service status. Ride-hail ranges are estimates; surge and legal airport pickup locations can differ.

Canadian tourist visa exemption does not resolve remote employment authorization, admitted duration, personal tax residence, employer tax/payroll/security duties or insurance cover. Activity-specific professional/official confirmation is needed.

Preliminary official-research.md claims additional law/PDF reads; the final sources.md explicitly limits them as insufficient retained evidence or failed retries. This page follows the final limits, not the preliminary claims. Future time rules and holiday hours require rechecking.
Health guidance is general; actual health risks, safe property water, clinical needs and medical/evacuation insurance are not individually assessed.
editingContract: English-only local draft adapted from finished-run materials. No Chinese file, new Review/stars, publication, website integration or shared package edits. No unhosted local artifacts linked in the reader body.
